# P11 photographic fixture

[p11-coffee.png](p11-coffee.png) is the original 600 × 400 coffee photograph from [scikit-image v0.25.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/coffee.png). Its [upstream provenance](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.25.2/skimage/data/_fetchers.py#L912) states: “No copyright restrictions. CC0 by the photographer (Rachel Michetti).” Courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar. Used only as fictional development media to exercise real image texture, decoding and normalized variants.
